analysis_notes.provenance: Translated English dub of a Chinese 2D animated web series (Chinese ticket board '门票价 800元', yuan prices, JD.com ad, Chinese names). Per BRIEF rule 5: study the structure only, never the story.

title_pattern: No title at all: hashtag-only caption '#cartoon #fyp'. On TikTok the video hook carries all the discovery; the caption only asks for feed placement. Nothing to copy except 'don't spend effort on the caption, spend it on the first 3 seconds'.

thumbnail.composition: Not a designed thumbnail: TikTok cover = frame 0. A 16:9 rounded-corner picture letterboxed in the middle of a black 9:16 canvas (picture covers only y~30-70%). Inside: the dinosaur behind a chain-link fence on the left third, mouth open over a red meat slab on a pole; two cartoon humans (director in black suit, narrator in neon-yellow jacket) standing on the right two-thirds, facing camera.
thumbnail.text: None on the cover itself (the first burned-in subtitle 'Our zoo bred a dinosaur.' appears in the video, not the cover).
thumbnail.colours: Very dark overall (heavy vignette/darkened grade): deep green foliage, black suit, grey mesh. Pops: neon-yellow jacket, red meat, pink-red dinosaur mouth and orange eye.
thumbnail.subject_scale_contrast: Moderate: the dinosaur head is about the size of a human torso and half hidden behind the fence; the threat is framed as 'caged' next to calm humans. Style contrast is stronger than scale: semi-realistic shaded creature vs flat chibi big-head humans.
thumbnail.why_it_works: On TikTok the cover barely matters (For You feed autoplays); the frame works because 'dinosaur + ordinary people' is an instant absurd/dangerous premise and the neon-yellow protagonist is recognisable across every later shot. The letterbox signals 'animated series episode' which this audience follows.
thumbnail.code_remake_notes: Trivial in SVG/Remotion: black 1080x1920 canvas, centred 1080x~770 rounded rect scene, fence as repeated vertical posts + diagonal mesh pattern, green bush silhouettes, two flat characters, a creature head SVG with gradient shading, dark radial vignette.

hook.first_5s_verbatim: Our zoo bred a dinosaur. The director made a fortune from it. But six months later, it knocked on my door.
hook.first_12s_verbatim: Our zoo bred a dinosaur. The director made a fortune from it. But six months later, it knocked on my door. "Dad, open the door. I'm starving. I want meat!" A chill ran down my spine. What was going on? The dinosaur could speak, and it called me Dad.
hook.device: Compressed backstory + 'But [time skip], it [came to my home]' inciting incident in 3 sentences (5.2 s), then an immediate impossible-detail line of monster dialogue ('Dad', 'I want meat') and the narrator voicing the viewer's question ('What was going on?'). First-person present danger, zero preamble, the monster is on screen by second 3.
open_loops: Why does it call him Dad?

beats.summary: Two-sentence premise plus inciting incident: our zoo bred a dinosaur, the director got rich, and six months later it knocked on MY door.
The monster speaks through the door: 'Dad, open the door. I'm starving. I want meat!' - a talking monster that calls the narrator 'Dad' (open question #1).

Phone call with keeper Wang Qiang: it escaped; the door is custom-made (false safety); confession that they spliced the narrator's genes into it so it could perform tricks. Explains 'Dad' while seeding guilt.
Greedy director forbids police ('cash cow', not broken even). Quick flashback of the dinosaur crushing a visitor's leg proves danger; narrator calls police anyway.
Neighbour Ms. Wang opens her door to complain and is pinned; narrator chooses to lock his door ('I'm no hero'). The dinosaur uses her hand on a fingerprint lock (intelligence escalation).
It eats her on the balcony in front of him on purpose; she wakes and curses him ('You'll die like me'); after eating it grows from 6 ft to 8 ft (rule: every kill makes it bigger).
Director arrives with tranquilizers and a net, refusing rifles; narrator insists; director admits T. rex DNA. Sets up a predictable failure.
In-dialogue ad: 'how are you calling me, wasn't your phone broken?' -> JD.com trade-in subsidy pitch with app screenshots.
Team reaches Room 804; struggle heard off-screen; silence; a knock on the narrator's door.

Peephole: only the director. Wang Qiang warns him; narrator deduces the lie (two men can't carry 800 lb down 8 floors; Zhang's ringtone next door). Director confesses, begs, cries; narrator refuses and lectures him.
Dinosaur kills the director instantly, eats all three, grows past 10 ft. Police delayed by snow: hold out 30 minutes.
Group-chat warning is mocked; the dead woman's husband thinks it's a prank; a paid volunteer livestreams from 804, finds no dinosaur, and the chat accuses the narrator of murder.
'Is something behind you?' - the dinosaur flings the streamer. Then the dead man's phone calls the narrator: 'Dad, I'm coming for you.' It can use phones and has learned to climb.
It crawls up the building toward him; he runs; police arrive and shoot it.

Wang Qiang calls: 'Did the police suspect you?' - narrator and keeper planned it; footage clears them, the director is dead, the zoo is theirs: 'We'll breed more dinosaurs and rule the world.' Hard cut, no CTA.

shot_list.visual_description: Night zoo enclosure: wire-mesh fence, a dark detailed raptor/T-rex grabs a red meat slab on a feeding pole (left); the zoo director (black suit, scowl) and narrator Chen Jie (neon-yellow jacket, pale wide-eyed face) stand right. Same frame is the cover/thumbnail.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Our zoo bred a dinosaur.

shot_list.visual_description: Zoo exterior: keeper in red jacket/cap beside a black ticket-price board (Chinese '门票价 800元'), dinosaur behind the fence.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The director made a fortune from it.

shot_list.visual_description: Apartment hallway (blue/orange striped wall): the dinosaur's head in profile at a door, mouth open, claw raised to knock.
shot_list.on_screen_text: But six months later, it knocked on my door. / I'm starving. I want meat!

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie inside by his front door, rigid, exaggerated meme-face eyes (tiny pupils), mouth agape.
shot_list.on_screen_text: A chill ran down my spine. / The dinosaur could speak.

shot_list.visual_description: Keeper Wang Qiang (red spiky hair, black-white hoodie) at the zoo fence by the ticket board, phone to ear.
shot_list.on_screen_text: And it called me Dad. / Then Wang Qiang called Chen Jie! / We can't find it anywhere.

shot_list.visual_description: Alternating singles: Chen Jie (blue phone, back to the door) vs Wang Qiang at zoo. ~3 cuts. Both faces switch between fear/anger expressions on line changes.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Stop searching! / It's outside my door. / Your door was custom-made. / Why can this dinosaur suddenly talk?

shot_list.visual_description: Wang Qiang close, guilty bug-eyed face, confessing.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Wang Qiang froze, then confessed. / So we added your genes.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie angry, squinting, lowers phone and hangs up.
shot_list.on_screen_text: You bastard! / Then I hung up.

shot_list.visual_description: Night park: Wang Qiang and the director; then director alone on phone, scowling, trees behind.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Wang Qiang told the director everything. / That dinosaur cost me a fortune. / I haven't broken even yet.

shot_list.visual_description: Flashback: a visitor lies on stepping stones inside the enclosure, dinosaur approaching; director at the ticket board refusing; dinosaur stomps on the visitor's leg. 4 quick shots.
shot_list.on_screen_text: A visitor fell into its enclosure. / The director refused to let anyone shoot. / The dinosaur crushed the visitor's leg.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie calls police; cut to dinosaur at the door again, pounding.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Remembering that, I called the police. / Right after I called, it pounded again.

shot_list.visual_description: Neighbour Ms. Wang (purple top, bob haircut, rosy cheeks) at her own door, annoyed.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Stop knocking this late! / I'll complain to management!

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie shouting through his door.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Get back inside!

shot_list.visual_description: Hallway: dinosaur lunges across frame and pins Ms. Wang to the floor, jaws over her face.
shot_list.camera_motion: fast slide-in of the creature, then hold
shot_list.on_screen_text: It instantly pinned her down. / Help! Don't eat me!

shot_list.visual_description: Long stretch on Chen Jie at his door: reaches for the handle, locks it, peers through peephole; 4-5 cuts between near-identical frames with changing facial expressions (fear, relief, smirk).
shot_list.on_screen_text: Ms. Wang begged me for help. / Then I locked my door. / Ms. Wang, I'm no hero. / It used her hand to unlock her door. / It understood fingerprint locks.

shot_list.visual_description: Night balcony of the neighbouring flat: dinosaur over Ms. Wang's body behind black railings, window and lamp behind.
shot_list.on_screen_text: It had dragged Ms. Wang outside. / When it saw me, it ate her openly.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie standing on his own balcony behind a white door frame, full-body, staring.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Damn it! This was deliberate. / What did this monster want?

shot_list.visual_description: Ms. Wang upside-down in the dinosaur's jaws through railings, bleeding, eyes open, crying out; intercut with Chen Jie in his bedroom apologising.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The pain suddenly woke her. / Chen Jie, why didn't you save me? / I hate you. You'll die like me!

shot_list.visual_description: Dinosaur alone on the balcony, head raised, roaring; scaled up between two shots to show growth.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Five minutes later, it finished eating. / Its body grew before my eyes.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie in dark bedroom (bed, red curtain).
shot_list.on_screen_text: How was that possible? / It should only reach six feet.

shot_list.visual_description: Director (suit) and a blond keeper in orange jacket in a grey corridor on the phone vs Chen Jie in bedroom; ~10 alternating cuts.
shot_list.on_screen_text: We brought tranquilizer guns. / Treat dinosaurs like children. / It's taller than a basketball player. / I added a little T. rex DNA.

shot_list.visual_description: Integrated ad: Chen Jie on phone while screenshots of the JD.com trade-in app (white/red/green UI cards) slide in on the right edge of the frame.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I used JD's trade-in program. / It only cost me two thousand yuan. / New phones get a five-hundred-yuan subsidy.

shot_list.visual_description: Director in front of Room 804 door with keepers; dinosaur flank glimpsed behind; arms crossed.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Five minutes later, they reached Room 804. / The dinosaur is inside. / It's my cash cow.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie at his door listening to the struggle; Wang Qiang calls again from the zoo; Chen Jie on phone.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Then I heard a fierce struggle. / Chen Jie, are you okay? / Soon, everything went quiet.

shot_list.visual_description: Peephole POV: circular fisheye mask on black, the director alone in the corridor, a diagonal white light beam across.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Only the director stood there. Everyone else was gone.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie reaching for the handle; hard cut to Wang Qiang yelling on the phone.
shot_list.on_screen_text: As I reached for the door, Wang Qiang yelled. / Chen Jie, don't open it!

shot_list.visual_description: Standoff: alternates peephole-POV director (pleading, sweating) with Chen Jie close-ups holding the phone; ~8 cuts. Deduction beats land on Chen Jie.
shot_list.on_screen_text: That dinosaur weighed at least eight hundred pounds. / His ringtone came from next door. / I'm sorry. I lied. / It's asleep now. But the drug will wear off soon.

shot_list.visual_description: Director bursts into tears in the peephole; Chen Jie refuses, cold expression.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Please! / You brought this on yourself. / You got those two keepers killed.

shot_list.visual_description: Corridor by door '808': the dinosaur rears up behind the director, jaws over his head.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Then the dinosaur appeared and killed him instantly.

shot_list.visual_description: Balcony: dinosaur eating; then grown dinosaur on the balcony against a moon.
shot_list.on_screen_text: It ate all three on the balcony. / After eating, it grew again, reaching over ten feet.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie in bedroom on the phone to police; a red/orange comic burst icon pops by the phone (ringing).
shot_list.on_screen_text: I called the police again. / But snow has blocked the roads.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie by the door typing in the group chat, phone held out.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I tagged everyone in the group chat. / There's a dinosaur in Room 804. / It has already killed four people.

shot_list.visual_description: Sceptical resident (black hair, black jacket) in a dim room, phone in hand; right third shows a dark strip with orange dino figurines.
shot_list.on_screen_text: What nonsense is this? / Dinosaurs have been extinct for ages.

shot_list.visual_description: Group-chat argument as alternating singles: Chen Jie vs Lou (blond, red hoodie, phone) in a dim room; ~6 cuts.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Chen Jie, isn't 804 my home? / Your wife was killed. / You're helping her prank me, aren't you? / I'll pay two thousand yuan.

shot_list.visual_description: Gao Xiang (muscular, tank top, gold chain) in a living room with a lamp and gold wall decor volunteers; Chen Jie messages him.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Hearing about the money, Gao Xiang volunteered. / That dinosaur is over ten feet tall! / Don't worry.

shot_list.visual_description: Gao Xiang inside 804's living room (yellow/grey sofa, window) with a stick and phone, livestreaming; intercut Lou and the sceptical resident and Chen Jie.
shot_list.on_screen_text: There's no dinosaur here. / I'm already inside your home. / There's no dinosaur, but your wife is dead. / Did you kill her and blame a dinosaur?

shot_list.visual_description: Same living room: dinosaur jaws descend into frame top-left behind Gao Xiang; next shot he is flung across the floor.
shot_list.camera_motion: creature slides in from frame edge, hard cut
shot_list.on_screen_text: Gao Xiang turned around. / The dinosaur stood right behind him. / It instantly knocked him across the room.

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie at his door, phone to ear, terrified as the dead man's phone calls him.
shot_list.on_screen_text: When I answered, the dinosaur spoke. / Damn it! It could use a phone!

shot_list.visual_description: Night exterior: huge dinosaur crawling along the building balconies toward camera, moon behind.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I looked and saw it had grown again. / It had learned to climb and was crawling toward me.

shot_list.visual_description: Stairwell: Chen Jie with police officers in hi-vis 'POLICE' vests; two officers nod.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The police arrived right then. / The dinosaur is in my home. / The officers nodded.

shot_list.visual_description: Dinosaur head lying on the floor by a door, dead.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Then they went upstairs and shot it.

shot_list.visual_description: Wang Qiang at the zoo on phone, calm.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Did the police suspect you?

shot_list.visual_description: Chen Jie in the stairwell, phone at ear, smug side-eye smirk for the final lines; cut ends abruptly.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Everything went smoothly. / Now the director is dead. / We'll breed more dinosaurs and rule the world.

pacing.shot_length_notes: 105 detected visual changes in 403.6 s (scene>0.08) -> ~106 shots, median ~3 s, range 0.7-15 s. Long holds (8-15 s) are always on the narrator's reaction face during voice-over; creature/attack inserts are short (1.5-4 s).
pacing.re_hook_interval_s: ~15-25 s: a new threat, reveal or rule appears roughly every 20 s (talks -> has your genes -> kills neighbour -> uses fingerprint lock -> grows -> director lies -> director killed -> grows -> nobody believes -> jump scare -> uses phone -> climbs -> twist).
pacing.subtitle_density: One short burned-in sentence at a time (4-9 words), synced to each line of dialogue; ~220 caption cues = a new caption every ~1.8 s.
pacing.dialogue_ratio: Roughly 55% character dialogue (phone calls, door talk, group chat) vs 45% first-person narration; narration lines are terse past-tense 'Then X happened.'
pacing.structure: Single continuous episode, escalating-threat ladder with a twist ending; no chapters, no CTA, one mid-roll integrated sponsor at 40% (2:40-2:52).

techniques_worth_copying: Three-sentence cold open: backstory in one line, consequence in one line, 'But N months later, it [came for me]' in the third. Monster speaks a line by second 5.

Monster-with-rules escalation: each kill makes it grow (6 ft -> 8 ft -> 10 ft -> bigger), and it learns a human skill each act (speech, fingerprint lock, phone, climbing). Every new rule is a re-hook.
Phone-call ping-pong as the main storytelling engine: two static characters alternate on calls, so exposition is dialogue not narration, and it costs one pose per character.
Door/peephole standoff with deduction: the protagonist catches a lie with concrete physical logic (800 lb, 8th floor, ringtone heard next door). Viewers love out-thinking the trap.
Morally grey narrator who chooses self-preservation ('I'm no hero', locks the door) and a victim who curses him: guilt + comment bait.
Greedy authority figure who refuses guns to protect profit and dies for it: karmic payoff the audience waits for.
Disbelief sub-plot via group chat / livestream: sceptics, a paid volunteer, an accusation against the narrator, then 'Is something behind you?' jump scare.
Last-10-seconds twist reframing the whole story (narrator and keeper engineered it), ending on a sinister sequel-bait line and a hard cut - drives rewatches and 'part 2?' comments.
Letterboxed 16:9 scene in a 9:16 canvas with small burned-in subtitles: reads as an 'episode' and lets one landscape render serve both YouTube and TikTok.
Visual economy: ~8 reusable sets (door, bedroom, zoo fence, corridor, balcony, peephole, living room, stairwell) and ~8 characters with swappable meme-face expressions carry 6.7 minutes.

code_only_remake_needs.feasibility: High. The original is limited 2D puppet animation: static sets, characters with expression swaps and mouth flaps, hard cuts, occasional creature slide-in and scale-up. Everything maps to Remotion + SVG.
assets: ~8 flat SVG sets in a dark palette: apartment door interior (with peephole + handle), bedroom (bed, curtain), corridor with numbered doors, exterior balcony with railings + moon, zoo fence/enclosure with ticket board, living room with sofa, stairwell, park at night.

Character rig in SVG: chibi big head + body, 6-8 swappable eye/brow/mouth expression sets (fear with tiny pupils, squint anger, smirk, crying), mouth-flap visemes, arm poses (phone at ear, phone held out, hand on door handle).

Original creature design (do NOT copy theirs): layered SVG with gradient shading so it looks heavier than the flat humans; poses for: at the door, lunge/pin, eating behind railings, roar, crawling on building, dead on floor; size variants for growth stages.
Peephole POV mask: circular fisheye vignette with barrel-distort feel (SVG mask + slight radial scale) and a diagonal light beam.
Phone/chat UI overlays (group chat bubbles, incoming call, livestream frame) as React components instead of real app screenshots.
Comic burst/impact icons, blood decals, red flash overlay for kills.
engine_features: Storyboard schema: shots of {set, characters[pose, expression, position], creature[pose, scale], overlay, caption}, one shot per dialogue line or two.
Letterbox layout: 16:9 rounded scene centred in 1080x1920, optional top/bottom title bands (the original leaves them empty; we could use the top band for a series title/part number).
Auto expression switching keyed to caption text/emotion tags; mouth flaps keyed to TTS word timestamps.

Shot templates: phone ping-pong (alternate singles per speaker), peephole POV, monster insert with slide-in/scale-up, jump-scare (creature enters frame edge + 2-frame shake), reaction hold with slow push-in.
Burned-in captions: one sentence at a time, small white sans with shadow at the bottom of the scene box, timed from TTS.
Multi-voice TTS (Kokoro: narrator, monster pitched-down, 4-5 side voices) + low drone bed, door-knock, roar and phone-ring SFX.
code_only_remake_needs.effort_estimate: One reusable horror kit (sets + rig + creature + 5 shot templates) then ~1 storyboard JSON per episode; a 6-7 min episode is ~100 shots, mostly template reuse.
